Based on the provided financial data, the company exhibits a very large scale (annualized revenue exceeding $100B and assets near $60B) but operates on thin profitability, with an operating margin of only 4% and a gross margin of 28%. Furthermore, its liquidity profile is slightly pressured, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.97 (current assets of $20,702M vs. current liabilities of $21,242M) and a moderately high leverage ratio (total liabilities-to-equity of approximately 2.87x). While its massive scale and positive net income ($689M for the quarter) support an investment-grade profile, the tight liquidity and low operating margins constrain the rating to the lower end of the investment-grade spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
